title: qhsJSON v4 Schema
description: Schema for CoachPrash educational content files (Questions, Hints, Solutions JSON).

subject_slug.description: Must match an existing Subject record in the database.

course_slug.description: Must match an existing Course record under the specified subject.

name.description: Display name of the topic. Use 'name' (not 'title') at the topic level.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique within the course. Auto-generated from name if omitted.

description.description: Brief topic description shown on the course page.

display_order.description: Sort order within the course. Defaults to array index.

title.description: Display title of the concept. Use 'title' (not 'name') at the concept level.

slug.description: Globally unique identifier. If a concept with this slug exists, it is reused. Auto-generated from title if omitted.

content_html.description: Full HTML lesson content. Supports LaTeX via \(...\) inline and \[...\] display.

content_raw.description: Plain text version of content for fallback/accessibility.

estimated_minutes.description: Estimated reading time in minutes. Defaults to 5.

access_tier.description: Controls access to lesson content. Defaults to 'free'.

display_order.description: Sort order within the topic. Defaults to array index.

title.description: Display title of the problem set (e.g., 'Practice: Linear Equations').

access_tier.description: Controls access to all problems in this set. Defaults to 'free'.

display_order.description: Sort order within the concept. Defaults to array index.

question_html.description: HTML question text. Supports LaTeX and data-bucket-key images.

question_raw.description: Plain text version of the question.

problem_type.description: Problem type: mcq (multiple choice), ftb (fill-in-the-blank), frq (free response), code (YouCode auto-graded Java).

correct_answer.description: Required for FTB (use || for multiple accepted answers). For FRQ, the model answer shown after submission.

choices.description: Required for MCQ problems. Typically 4 choices with exactly 1 correct.

hints.description: Progressive hints. Recommended: 2 per problem (first free, second costs 1 point).

access_tier.description: Optional per-problem access tier. Usually controlled at problem_set level instead.

starter_code.description: Pre-filled code template shown in the editor for 'code' type problems.

test_harness.description: Test configuration for 'code' problems. Types: output_match (compare stdout), method_test (run test cases against a method).

wrap_in_main.description: For output_match: wrap student code in main().

method_name.description: For method_test: the method to test.

class_name.description: For method_test: class name. Defaults to Solution.

parts_json.description: Multi-part FRQ structure for AP-style problems. Each part has its own method, test cases, and rubric.

frq_metadata.description: AP FRQ metadata for released exam questions.

rubric.description: Rubric items for FRQ self-grading or code problem grading criteria.

sample_answer.description: Alias for correct_answer on FRQ problems. Prefer correct_answer (the loader reads correct_answer).

acceptable_answers.description: Additional accepted answers for FTB. Prefer using || in correct_answer instead.

explanation_html.description: Additional explanation HTML shown after answering.

is_correct.description: Exactly one choice per MCQ must be true.

oneOf.description: Simple hint text string. cost_points defaults to 0.

hint_text.description: Alias for text. Accepted by loader but prefer 'text'.

cost_points.description: 0 = free hint, 1 = costs 1 point to reveal.

oneOf.description: Simple step text string. step_number auto-incremented.

text_html.description: Alias for text. Accepted by loader but prefer 'text'.
